hello.text: Mind the comfrey. No, that's tansy, mind it too. Hello! Did you want something, or are you just lost? Everyone's a bit lost here.

making.text: Rushlights. Rush, peel, fat, dip. Then the sleeping draught for Aubin: dreamroot, lemon balm, a pinch of valerian so you don't lie there thinking. Then supper. Then more rushlights.

garden.text: Cabbages, pumpkins, sage, feverfew, and something Aubin planted that nobody can name and nothing eats. I leave it alone. It leaves me alone. We get on.

slept.text: You're up! Head clear? The valerian does that, a bit of fog for an hour. Sit on the bench if you like. Not on the chamomile.
